en: Colorized panoramic view over a large European river city, showing a suspension bridge crossing the Danube with many steam boats and barges on the water. The viewpoint is from a green hillside with rocky outcrops and buildings below. On both riverbanks there are dense rows of multi‑story historic buildings, boulevards, and promenades. In the distant background another bridge and a large parliament-like building are visible. Red printed caption text appears at the top in Hungarian and German.
